title: Ram TRX vs Raptor R: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Two trucks, two supercharged V8s, and almost the same horsepower. The Ram TRX and the Ford F one fifty Raptor R have been compared for years, and the comparison keeps changing, because the numbers keep changing. Seven hundred two against seven hundred. Then seven hundred seventy-seven against seven hundred twenty. This is the real difference between them, and the places where our sources disagree. We read Motor1, Motor Authority, Autoblog, Ford Authority's report of a MotorTrend test, Cars dot com, Edmunds, Kelley Blue Book, Wikipedia, and both companies' own releases. We label company claims as claims, and our own arithmetic as ours. And we show every conflict, because for these two trucks, the conflicts are the story.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
